title: Suits S03E12 | "No One Gets An A+" – The Fake Grade That’s About To Destroy Mike Ross
description:
The brilliant, high-stakes illusion of Mike Ross's Harvard pedigree hits a devastatingly dangerous wall in this intense sequence from Season 3! When high-powered closer Harvey Specter catches wind that a legendary Harvard professor is coming to the firm for a guest lecture, Mike's carefully fabricated transcript becomes a ticking time bomb. Confronted by Harvey over a statistical impossibility—an "A+" grade from a notoriously brutal professor who never hands them out—Mike's composure completely shatters. Backed into a corner, the boy wonder drops a raw, vulnerable confession: for the first time in his life, his photographic memory wasn't enough to pass an exam that relied entirely on live lectures. Trapped, panicked, and staring down a failing grade that would end his career before it started, Mike reveals the exact illegal second he hacked the professor's computer to save his own skin.

[Interactive Questions]

"I decided to save myself." On a scale of 1-10, how completely intense was it to finally hear Mike admit he actually failed an exam? 🤯📉

Be honest: Was changing his grade in the system the smartest risk Mike ever took, or was it the ultimate mistake that doomed him? 🤷‍♂️💼

Drop a 🔥 in the comments if Suits has the best high-stakes dialogue in TV history! 👇
